full_judgment: 12. The production of a certified copy of a sale-deed does not, however, warrant the presumption of due execution of the original document. A party producing secondary evidence of a document is not relieved of the duty of proving the execution of the original. Even in a case where a document is exhibited without objection the Court is to be satisfied as to the execution of the document.
